_comment: Library tag vocabulary. Tags cross-cut the categories in catalog.json: a category is the ONE shelf a document sits on, a tag is every other way somebody might look for it. Both clients render these as filter chips (native src/gui/pages/library.rs, web web/pages/library-app.js). Adding a tag means adding a row here and using its id in catalog.json; `scripts/build-library.js` fails the build if a catalog tag is not defined here, so the two cannot drift. Grouped by axis, and rendered in the order given.
